package.name: spr_remote_control
package.description: Sentry remote-control unified package (merged from the Python spr_remote_control and C++ spr_remote_control_cpp). All input sources publish the same unified cmd_vel (geometry_msgs/Twist) and gimbal_controller/gimbal_cmd (spr_msgs/GimbalCmd): - rc_serial_remote_cpp (C++17): DJI DR16/DT7 receiver DBUS over serial (100000 bps) - keyboard_remote (Python): keyboard source for mock / MuJoCo debugging
